[[Pledge Grove]] }} '''Pokédex Lecture''' (Japanese: '''VSタマゲタケ''' ''VS {{tt|Tamgetake|Foongus}}''), titled '''VS Foongus''' in the [[Shogakukan Asia]] translation, is the 529th chapter of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, and the fifth chapter of the {{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}. It is subtitled '''Foongus''' (Japanese: '''ポケデクス・レクチャー''' ''Pokédex Lecture'') in the [[VIZ Media]] translation and '''Pokédex Lecture''' in the Shogakukan Asia translation. ==Plot== {{Incomplete plot}} ==Major events== * {{adv|Blake}} takes {{adv|Whitley}} to the [[Pledge Grove]] to register Pokémon in the [[Pokédex]] as a way to get closer to her. * Whitley accidentally attracts [[Kelden|Keldeo]], who proceeds to attack the duo. * Blake manages to get out of the way, but Whitley is knocked unconscious. * Whitley flashes back to the day she met her {{p|Foongus}}. * Whitley's Foongus is revealed to have the nickname [[Foongy]]. * Blake takes Whitley back to the school. {{Adventuresevents}} {{endspoilers}} ===Debuts=== ====Pokémon debuts==== ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{adv|Blake}} * {{adv|Whitley}} * {{adv|Cheren}} * {{adv|N}} (flashback) * [[Rood]] (flashback) * Whitley's [[mother]] (flashback) * {{adv|Maya}} * {{adv|Yuko}} * {{adv|Yuki}} * {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s (flashback) * Classmates ===Pokémon=== * {{p|Dewott}} ({{OP|Blake|Dewott}}) * {{p|Genesect}} ({{OP|Blake|Genesect}}; flashback) * {{p|Foongus}} ([[Foongy]]; {{adv|Whitley}}'s) * {{p|Roserade}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Houndoom}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Shelmet}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Solosis}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Petilil}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Pidove}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Sandile}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Swadloon}} ([[Team Plasma]]'s; flashback) * {{p|Keldeo}} ([[Kelden|Adventures]]) ==Trivia== * Two girls that resemble Mirei Minami and Sophy Hōjō from the {{wp|PriPara|Prism Paradise}} series can be seen walking in the background of a panel. {{-}} {{MangaPrevNext/Adventures |prevcode=PS528 |prevtitle=Innocent Scientist |nextcode=PS530 |nexttitle=Movie Panic |series=Black 2 & White 2 |colorscheme=Unova2}} {{Project Manga notice}} [[de:VS.
